account.title: Your writing identity.
account.sub: Shown on collaboration panels, manuscript metadata, and Shadow Agent reports.
account.display_name_desc: How collaborators and Shadow reports see you.
account.pen_name_desc: Used on exported PDF / EPUB. Leave blank to use display name.
account.email_desc: Used for sign-in and account recovery.
account.two_factor_desc: Use an authenticator app for one-time codes.
account.export_all_desc: Download every manuscript, element, Shadow record, and version history.
account.delete_account_desc: Manuscripts retained for 30 days, then permanently deleted. Reversible within the grace period.

appearance.title: You decide the light at your desk.
appearance.sub: Pick a brightness. Whether Shadow mode also shifts the palette is up to you.
appearance.shadow_affects_theme_desc: On: entering Shadow turns the page cool and plum. Off: only the right panel changes.
appearance.animations_desc: Orb breathing, tab swaps, the Shadow-mode wash.

editor.title: How letters land on the page.
editor.sub: Editor typography and focus behavior — independent of export.
editor.font_size_desc: Editor view only; export is unaffected.
editor.indent_desc: Editor view only. Export uses its own settings.
editor.max_width_desc: Maximum width of the centered column.
editor.focus_line_desc: Dim everything except the current scope.
editor.entity_highlight_desc: Add a dotted underline to recognized people / places / items.
editor.auto_link_desc: Auto-detect existing element names while you type and link them.
editor.margin_notes_desc: Show annotation cards on the right margin.

language.title: What language the UI speaks.
language.sub: UI language only — manuscript and Shadow reply languages are below.
language.manuscript_default_desc: Affects spellcheck, line-breaking, and Shadow Agent reply language.
language.spellcheck_desc: CJK uses a dictionary; English uses the system spell checker.

sync.title: Where your work lives, and where it's backed up.
sync.sub: Drifting syncs end-to-end encrypted by default. Local repo and cloud are mirrors.
sync.wifi_only_desc: Avoid mobile data on iPad / iPhone.
sync.auto_snapshot_desc: Every 5 minutes per chapter; kept for 90 days.
sync.milestones_desc: Mark a permanent snapshot, not subject to 90-day retention.
sync.export_all_desc: DOCX · EPUB · PDF · Markdown · plain text.
sync.import_files_desc: From Scrivener / Word / Markdown / plain text.
